newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stocks seen firmer as U.S. strengthens.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks seen firmer as U.S. strengthens.

text.p: *Stocks seen firmer with stronger offshore finishes. "I think we will be a little better with the U.S. and London up. Nickel is the only downer," said Peter Struk of Reynolds and Co.
*On Wall Street, a buying spree in technology stocks sent U.S. indices sailing to record highs.
*ADRs: News Corp 17-3/8 (-1/2), BHP 27-5/8 (-2-1/8), WMC 25-3/4 (+1/8), National Australia Bank 72-1/8 (-1/4)
*Gold price was firmer, on LME nickel spiralled lower, breaching successive layers of support amid liquidation and technical selling. The others were less energetic.
